definitions.explanation: The quality of attracting or captivating people.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}には{独特|どくとく}の{魅力|みりょく}がある。
この{町|まち}の{魅力|みりょく}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What is the appeal of this town?

examples.japanese: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な{人|ひと}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become an attractive person.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{魅力|みりょく}がある (to have charm)
・{魅力|みりょく}を{感|かん}じる (to feel attracted to)
・{魅力|みりょく}に{引|ひ}かれる (to be drawn to the appeal of)
・{魅力的|みりょくてき} (attractive, charming - na-adjective)

DERIVED WORDS:
・{魅力的|みりょくてき} (charming, attractive)
・{魅|み}せる (to charm, to captivate)
・{魅了|みりょう}する (to fascinate, to captivate)

NOTE:
The kanji {魅|み} relates to supernatural charm or captivation, as in {魅惑|みわく} (fascination).
